rule: Every published factual row carries a link to an official source, or is blank and explicitly flagged
threshold: 0 rows with a value and no source link
evidence: Enforced by nfl-desk-a59c762a/verify_desk.py; negative-control tests cover a stripped link, a filled blank and a deleted flag

rule: No model input may carry information dated after the kickoff of the game it predicts
threshold: 0 inputs dated after the predicted game's kickoff
evidence: Every Week-11 line row records recorded_at_utc 2026-11-19T07:05:00Z, before the first Week-11 kickoff at 8:15 PM ET on 2026-11-19

rule: Train, validation and final holdout windows are chronological and disjoint
threshold: 3 disjoint chronological windows, final holdout never touched during fitting
evidence: Train weeks 1-8 (121 games), validation week 9 (15), final holdout week 10 (14). The model is fitted on the train window only

rule: Every strategy and every rule is frozen before the evaluation window opens
threshold: 1 registered rule per strategy with a commit hash
evidence: 3 strategies and 2 controls registered in data/pre_registration.csv before the first Week-11 kickoff

rule: No leaderboard cell may contain a backtest-derived number
threshold: 0 leaderboard cells with a backtest-derived value
evidence: The leaderboard holds prospective columns only. The verifier fails if any of them is filled from the shadow backtest

rule: Signal and staking are separate columns and a staking return may never be shown without a signal score
threshold: 2 separate column groups on every leaderboard row
evidence: leaderboard.csv carries signal_score and staking_return as distinct columns

rule: Every scoring run includes a random control and a favourites-only control
evidence: Both controls appear on the removal-of-luck panel with their own n

rule: The number of trials is declared and the significance threshold is adjusted
evidence: 3 trials are declared on the removal-of-luck panel, so the adjusted alpha is 0.01667

rule: Ranking uses a benchmark-relative proper score with an uncertainty, never win rate
threshold: a benchmark-relative Brier skill score with n and an interval
evidence: The shadow backtest reports Brier skill against climatology with n and a Fisher interval. The leaderboard is unscored because no prospective game has been played

rule: A parlay or a prop combo may be ranked only when a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void and push rules are both available
evidence: No combo is registered. Both prerequisites are absent: no validated joint probability and no admitted operator rule set

rule: A market residual, a closing-line value or a realised return requires an admitted, timestamped price source
threshold: 1 admitted source with a quote timestamp per market
evidence: No admitted source exists. All 39 price-snapshot rows are blank and flagged

rule: A depth-based feature requires a verified depth order for all 32 clubs or a verified official play-time source
threshold: 32 of 32 clubs verified on one route
evidence: Route (a) is verified for 31 clubs. Route (b) has no verified official source. The backup-deficiency feature is therefore not built

rule: A live strategy that loses its skill evidence is returned to paper
threshold: a demotion rule with a trigger, a window and a review action
evidence: The rule is registered. It has not been exercised because no strategy has been live and no prospective score exists

rule: An availability read may only be used if its clock time precedes the kickoff it informs
threshold: read_at_utc earlier than the kickoff of every game it informs
evidence: The Week-11 injury report was read at 2026-11-19T06:45Z, before the 8:15 PM ET kickoff
